items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] don't know whether you—I don't remember them. ... I don't remember that, if I were even there.

ctx.x: don't know whether you—I don't remember them.

And then I guess he finally comes in. At the moment they weren't really rehearsing, just jamming. Mostly Dixieland standards like Panama, Copenhagen, Eccentric, Tiger Rag, Tin Roof, and Pop Tunes. Margie, All By Myself, Hoo, Alabama Bound, Oh Sister Ain't That Hot, Linger A While, The Sheik of Arabia. These things, they stuck to the easier natural keys. C, B flat, E flat, E flat, F natural. They did what? They were stuck to the easier natural keys like C, B flat, E flat, F natural, G natural. Marais got out his…
No, I haven't. Has he talked to you? No, and I'd like to catch up with him, I can tell you that.
